summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Collector Parfum CMS (E9 extended: seo, home_layout, gallery, shop_page, locations_page, voucher_page + contact new fields). Backend pytest 6/6 passed. Frontend Playwright validated: section list, home_layout FAQ toggle hide/show, gallery multi-pick from MediaManager + save + storefront render (masonry) + lightbox, revert-to-default, all page preview iframe routes (shop_page->/shop, locations_page->/lokasi, voucher_page->/voucher, contact->/kontak, about->/tentang), and shop_page title edit end-to-end (title 'Semua aroma, satu' visible on /shop). Storefront regression clean.

issues: Console warning: cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production. Consider replacing CDN with the installed PostCSS/CLI build to remove the warning (frontend uses tailwind PostCSS already, so investigate stray CDN <script> reference).

action_items: Investigate/remove any stray reference to cdn.tailwindcss.com in the app (search index.html/public/*) — non-blocking, just a console warning.

Optional UX: after revert-to-default with unchanged payload, the 'Sudah diedit' green dot correctly disappears; minor cosmetic — one lingering indicator observed once during rapid revert cycles (likely stored data equals default only after a subsequent refetch).
critical_code_review_comments: content_registry.py is ~460 lines and dense — consider splitting SECTIONS by group (global/home/pages) into separate modules for maintainability.
services/content.py _coerce: gallery caption/to string cast on None -> str(None) becomes 'None' via `str(row.get('caption') or '')` — properly guarded with `or ''`. Good.

AdminContentPage.js select() blocks navigation on dirty via window.confirm(); this can trap in automation but is fine for humans. Consider a non-blocking confirm dialog with data-testid for testability.
Section 'category_section' correctly removed from SECTIONS and default_content; GET /api/content excludes it. Verified.
seed_data_creation: None. All CMS mutations reverted to defaults after tests (gallery items=[], home_layout gallery visible=false, shop_page title back to 'Semua parfum, satu').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend CMS tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_cms.py (pytest). Media Manager has 4 external Unsplash thumbnails (id via [data-testid=admin-media-tile]). MediaPickerDialog: click tile's inner <button> (onOpen=toggle) OR data-testid=admin-media-tile-checkbox; confirm via data-testid=admin-media-picker-confirm. Home layout toggles use data-testid=cms-toggle-visible-<i> where i is index in home_layout.sections (14=FAQ, 11=Gallery). Storefront gallery testids: home-gallery, home-gallery-item-<i>, home-gallery-strip/grid/masonry.
rca of the issue: No functional issues observed. Backend coerce validated: bogus select->'', invalid gallery items dropped/normalized, toggle string->bool. Preview iframe route mapping is correct — an earlier flaky FAIL for shop_page was caused by a residual dirty-state confirm dialog blocking select(); confirmed correct once dialog auto-accept was installed.
